    "The Kreg screw kit connects to my recent wood screw purchases because it could support another wood assembly task, provided its sizes and pocket-hole requirements fit my project.",

    "The recommendations seem to treat interest in construction fasteners as interest in almost any workshop supply.",
    "They seem to assume that products used for attaching or repairing things serve the same purpose, even when they involve different materials and tasks."

  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of wood screws and framing nails suggest that fastening method, dimensions and compatibility matter more than a broad connection to tools.",
    "My medicine cups and vacuum bags point to separate, specific household needs; they do not establish a need for unrelated liquid storage or repair equipment.",
    "I choose supplies when they fit a current task, so a useful-sounding assortment or large pack is not enough on its own."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my fastening needs but stretched that interest into unrelated workshop tasks."
